name_zh: 保罗·亨宁/乐高/邦·奥尔森：设计工程商业化与系统性创新
name_en: Paul Henningsen/LEGO/Børge Olsen: Design Engineering Commercialization & Systemic Innovation
description_zh: 丹麦设计工程传统由三代跨越百年传承：保罗·亨宁 (1894-1967) 以 PH 灯系统确立"功能决定形式、光学科学化"的设计工程范式；乐高集团 (1932创立，高德弗雷·克里斯蒂安森 1958 专利积木) 将模块化标准化推向极致，构建"玩具即平台"的生态系统；邦·奥尔森 (1928-2018) 以系统家具 (1960s) 推动工业化住宅与办公空间标准化。三者共同体现 M158 通才整合——跨光学/材料/制造/商业/人因工程的全息原型验证。核心机制：模块化标准→平台生态→用户共创→品牌护城河。
description_en: Danish design engineering tradition across three generations: Poul Henningsen (1894-1967) established PH lamp system—"function determines form, optics scientized"; LEGO Group (founded 1932, Godtfred Christiansen 1958 brick patent) took modular standardization to extreme, building "toy as platform" ecosystem; Børge Olsen (1928-2018) with system furniture (1960s) drove industrialized housing/office standardization. All three exemplify M158 Polymath Integration—holographic prototype validation across optics/materials/manufacturing/commerce/human-factors. Core mechanism: modular standard → platform ecosystem → user co-creation → brand moat.
reason_zh: 丹麦设计非单纯美学，而是"工程化美学"：科学原理(光学/人因)→模块化标准→工业化制造→商业平台。三代人跨百年接力，展示 M158 通才整合与 M151 信任资本在商业生态中的复利。
reason_en: Danish design is not mere aesthetics but "engineered aesthetics": scientific principles (optics/ergonomics) → modular standards → industrial manufacturing → commercial platform. Three generations century-long relay shows M158 Polymath Integration & M151 Trust Capital compounding in business ecosystems.
steps_zh: 科学原理先行：亨宁用对数螺旋线计算灯罩曲率，消除眩光（纯物理学）
模块化标准定义：乐高积木 1958 专利公差 0.002mm，反向兼容 60+ 年
平台化生态构建：乐高 Ideas/Technic/Education 让用户成共创者，IP 授权双向奔赴
系统家具工业化：奥尔森模块化储物/办公系统，适配丹麦福利国家公共建设采购
品牌护城河深化：设计博物馆收藏+版权保护+高端定价+教育渗透，形成文化壁垒
steps_en: Scientific principles first: Henningsen used logarithmic spiral for shade curvature, eliminating glare (pure physics)
Modular standard definition: LEGO brick 1958 patent tolerance 0.002mm, backward compatible 60+ years
Platform ecosystem building: LEGO Ideas/Technic/Education make users co-creators, IP licensing two-way
System furniture industrialization: Olsen modular storage/office systems fitted Danish welfare state public procurement
Brand moat deepening: Design museum acquisitions + IP protection + premium pricing + education permeation = cultural barrier
expected_zh: 小国非依靠自然资源，以"设计工程"为核心竞争力，构建全球品牌护城河，实现高值制造与文化输出双赢。
expected_en: Small nation without natural resources builds global brand moat via "design engineering" core competency, achieving high-value manufacturing & cultural export win-win.
case_zh: 乐高 2023 营收 659 亿丹麦克朗，品牌价值全球前十；PH 灯永久收藏 MoMA/蓬皮杜；奥尔森系统家具铺货全球机场/大学/政府。
case_en: LEGO 2023 revenue DKK 65.9B, brand value global top 10; PH lamps permanent MoMA/Centre Pompidou; Olsen systems in airports/universities/governments worldwide.
cross_cultural_impact: Global design education curriculum; modular platform business model; Scandinavian design brand equity
spiritual_tradition: Lutheran craft ethics + Grundtvigian democratic design
colonial_history: No direct colonial design legacy; Greenlandic craft influence contemporary
diaspora_influence: Danish designers shaped US mid-century modern (Eames collaboration)
indigenous_knowledge_system: Inuit material culture influences contemporary Arctic design (indirect)
